chalisa.cau1: First I bow my head to the Guru, and fix my mind on the feet of Śrī Hari. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Friend, I sing a wondrous song; by holding to it one's boat is carried across. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Arjuna said: Listen, Lord: you have told of your many forms. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: I have not understood the difference between them at all; be gracious, wise one, and tell me again. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: One meditates on you every day and sets his mind on you with devotion, ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: sings your virtues night and day, and nothing other than you pleases his mind; ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: he repeats your name day and night and speaks of nothing else. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: The other meditates on the formless, and calls it imperishable, unseen and beginningless. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Both are given to meditation; which of them is the better, son of Nanda? ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: The Lord said to Arjuna: Listen, dear one, and give it some attention. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: One who repeats my name and has others repeat it, whose eyes fill with tears of love, ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: who wants nothing but me, and sings my virtues night and day, ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: whose hair stands on end again and again when he hears my name spoken, ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: those whose thread does not break for a moment — their faith is firm and boundless. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: One who is joined to me and fixes his mind in meditation, and in meditation is overwhelmed, ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: whose throat is choked so that he cannot speak, whose mind and intellect are absorbed in me, ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: who forgets shame, fear and pride, and has no awareness left of his own body: ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: one who fixes his mind in meditation in this way is called the best of yogīs. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Whoever meditates on the form without attributes, the complete Brahman, unmoving and incomparable, ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: which all the Vedas call formless, and whose depth the mind and intellect cannot find, ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: which never perishes, which pervades all things like the sky, ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: which is steadfast, beginningless and bliss itself, which only a rare yogī knows; ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: who meditates so without a break, and regards all as one and the same, ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: keeps his mind and senses under his control, and never tastes the pleasures of the senses, ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: and is devoted to the welfare of all beings: such is their true creed. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: They too reach me alone, and surely go to the supreme goal. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: The fruit of both is the same, but meditation on the attributeless is hard. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: As long as there is pride in the mind, it is hard to gain knowledge. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: For those whose love is for the attributeless, the practice and its rules are hard to accomplish. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: The mind has no support on which to rest; so that practice is hard beyond measure. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: The easy way, that of Brahman with attributes, I have told you. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: Offering to me all his countless works, sacrifice, charity and the rest, ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: one who fixes his mind on me unwavering, regards me as his very life, ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: breaks off his love for all the world, and regards me as his friend, ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: who is absorbed in love beyond all measure and sees this world as empty: ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: those whose mind is always in me, friend, I love them dearly. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Becoming the boatman, I row the boat and bring them across the ocean of worldly existence. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: This is the highest knowledge of all; so meditate on me. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Then you will become like me; know that what I say is true. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Whoever walks according to this, he too crosses the ocean of worldly existence. ॥40॥
